raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With DeepSeek-V4.1's `--enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay`, the layers after the last kv_source layer attend over only the last `min(window, extend_len)` rows of each prefill extend. An extend shorter than the window therefore gives the prompt's first sampled token a truncated window.

This happens on a prefix-cache hit that leaves fewer than `window` uncached rows, and on a chunked prefill whose final chunk is shorter than `window`.

## Modifications

- A prefix-cache hit now stops at least one sliding window short of the prompt when decoder bounded replay is on. Only a hit that would have left less than a window is shortened, by at most one page. `swa_reprefill_tail_tokens()` returns `sliding_window_size` when the new `CacheInitParams.decoder_swa_bounded_replay` is set.
- The late-layer window of a final prefill chunk shorter than the window is now floored at `seq_len - window` instead of at the chunk start, so the chunk reads the previous chunk's tail rows, which already hold their late-layer KV. This is a two line change in `late_layer_tail_layout`.
- A streaming session turn that borrows its slot's record skips the hold-back: the record is the request's own KV, whose last window is already written. `swa_reprefill_tail_tokens(req)` takes the request for this.
- A prefix hit now runs the same rows with the same window floors as a cold prefill. A short final chunk does not: its tail reads the previous chunk's tail rows, which were computed under that chunk's floor. The short-chunk table below measures the difference.

## Accuracy Tests

4xB200, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash TP4/EP4, greedy, 12 prompts per row, at the first generated position. Flips count prompts whose sampled token changed; shift is the median change of the reference's sampled-token logprob, in nats.

**Prefix hit.** An 8192-token cached prefix plus N fresh tokens, against a cold prefill of the same prompt.

| uncached rows | flips, stock | flips, fixed | shift, stock | shift, fixed |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 10/12 | 1/12 | 2.40 | 0.03 |
| 2 | 7/12 | 3/12 | 0.90 | 0.15 |
| 8 | 3/12 | 2/12 | 0.44 | 0.09 |
| 32 | 2/12 | 0/12 | 0.003 | 0.002 |
| >= 127 | 0/12 | 0/12 | 0.000 | 0.000 |

**Short final chunk.** A cold 16384 + m token prompt prefilled with a 16384-token chunk size, so its final chunk has m rows, against the same prompt prefilled as one 8192 + m extend after priming its first 8192 tokens.

| final chunk rows m | flips, stock | flips, fixed | shift, stock | shift, fixed |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 5/12 | 0/12 | 0.45 | 0.000 |
| 2 | 4/12 | 1/12 | 0.26 | 0.000 |
| 4 | 1/12 | 0/12 | 0.005 | 0.000 |
| 8 | 1/12 | 0/12 | 0.003 | 0.000 |
| 16 to 127 | 0/12 | 0/12 | 0.000 | 0.000 |

`test_unified_radix_cache_unittest.py`: 2789 run on 1xH100, OK (1504 config skips), 1 new case. `test_unified_cache_linker.py`: 32 passed, one existing test updated.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

The prefix-match limit only applies when a hit would leave fewer than `window` uncached rows, and then recomputes at most one page. The floor change costs each token of a short final chunk at most a full window of 128 keys to score.

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

nodes.body: Simpler fix for the short final chunk: floor the tail window at `max(0, seq_len - SWA_WINDOW)` instead of `seq_len - tail_len` ([here](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/211b1d9784d15845566081cc25c8103ce43cc4f2/python/sglang/kernels/ops/attention/dsv4_attn_metadata_kernels.py#L451) and [here](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/211b1d9784d15845566081cc25c8103ce43cc4f2/python/sglang/kernels/ops/attention/dsv4_attn_metadata_kernels.py#L465)). The previous chunk's tail already wrote those slots, so `_hold_back_final_chunk` isn't needed. The previous chunk's tail already wrote those slots, so `_hold_back_final_chunk` isn't needed. Keep the [prefix-hit cap](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/211b1d9784d15845566081cc25c8103ce43cc4f2/python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/unified_radix_cache.py#L3554).
